steps: Both new starter options show exact ordinary GDScript source in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px. Mode, path, focus, source and reachable Create/Cancel controls persist; cancelling writes nothing.
Create opens an ordinary unsaved TXT draft; Save adds exactly its source and registration while preserving all existing author files.

Manage existing behavior explicitly registers one script reference. The ordinary behavior editor adds one character binding and two text parameters, retains every consumer binding, and preserves focus/review in three languages. Apply changes only a draft; Save changes only the behavior JSON.
